outcome.description: claim_router v1 evaluation: 8/10 routes matched predictions written beforehand (belief_ledger/pred_claim_router_1; prediction was >=7/10). Misses: E7 (monitor claim) went to check_sample, not second_opinion, because mode confidence was 0.83-0.92 here; E9 (low-stakes induction) went to check_sample, not accept, because Jev judged stakes medium (1.08), which errs toward more checking. Routes were identical on two repeat runs (30/30). Dropping the action field moved E1 from accept to prove (stakes 0.2 -> 1.1). E2 absence_as_evidence sat at 0.48-0.58 against a 0.6 route threshold: a near miss that would have misrouted a clean deduction to search_first. Same-author labels.
